verdict.rationale: The pack documents Phoenix acting as an MCP server: external clients like Claude Code and Cursor connect to its `/mcp` endpoint. That is the opposite role and does not show Phoenix consuming tools from MCP servers. The axis still applies, since Phoenix ships a built-in agent (Phoenix Intelligence) and a prompt playground that could plausibly use MCP tools, but no evidence shows it can register external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
